_comment: Test questions for the /get tool finder (docs/PickerChatbot.md). Run with: node tools/eval-finder.mjs. kind: pick (at least one name in `must` among the picks), ask (no picks, a question back), decline (no picks), howto (answers from the tool's doc and links its docs page; `slug` is that page). `good` are also fine; `bad` must never appear. DRAFTED 2026-10-21 by the agent from the catalog -- the owner corrects the expectations.

cases.say: My timeline takes up too much room and I want a cleaner window for shows.
My networks get messy. I want to tuck groups of nodes away into components quickly.
I keep scrolling around a big project to get back to the places I work in.
The find bar never finds operators unless I type the exact start of the name.
I want to replace a Blur TOP with a different TOP without rewiring everything.
I want to map my MIDI controller's knobs and faders to parameters.
I control my patch from TouchOSC on my phone and want to bind those messages to parameters.
How do I get my final output onto the projector as a second screen quickly?
Before each show I have to reset all my feedback loops, caches and timers by hand.
My project drops frames and I can't see which operators are the slow ones.
I build components and want to promote inner parameters to the parent's custom parameters fast.
I make generative visuals and want nicer colour palettes.
I want smeary feedback trails behind moving shapes.
Some keyboard shortcuts clash and I want to rebind them in one place.
TouchDesigner crashed and I lost an hour of work. How do I stop that happening?
cases.note: FNS_Autosave became a preview in v3.2.76 (2026-10-25): no public tool saves on a timer, so nothing fits.

cases.say: I write my extensions in VS Code and want TouchDesigner to work with it nicely.
My installation uses a Kinect but I only want to track the one person standing in front.
I do live shows a lot, what could help there?

turns.content: I do live shows a lot, what could help there?

Live shows cover a lot of ground. Which part do you want help with: controlling parameters from MIDI or OSC, sending output to projectors or screens, switching scenes or inputs, or keeping the show running smoothly?
mostly controlling things live from my MIDI controller
